description: Search the curated studies by keywords, optionally filtered by evidence code, a linked entity (gene, drug, disease...) and year range. Searches title, finding, authors (author-list form "Sabatini DM" and full names of profiled authors), PMID, DOI, PMCID, linked entities and their synonyms, journal, model system and the abstract excerpt. A query that is a PMID or DOI returns that study. Returns summary records with evidence codes and URLs.

entity.description: Only studies linked to this entity (name, synonym or id), e.g. "Rheb".

evidence_code.description: Keep only these evidence codes, e.g. ["H","S"] for human evidence.

limit.description: Maximum 50; a larger value is capped at 50.

offset.description: For the next page: pass next_offset from the previous answer.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "rapamycin lifespan mice", a person ("Claudio De Virgilio"), a PMID or a DOI. Omit to list by filters only.

name: search_studies
title: Search studies
